lastChange.note: Version 1.7.2: fixed Multi select's row checkboxes and Entity's selectable-row checkbox rendering as unstyled native checkboxes (blue, browser default) instead of the system's ink checked state — both now match the Selection pattern (.gf-check): ink fill, white mark, no colour drift. 1.7.1: fixed the Video component overlay toggle (no ring at rest, grey hover/press, focus outline never Raggio). Version 1.7.0: five components after a further review of Vercel Geist — Banner (persistent, non-dismissable project notice), Show more (progressive disclosure, focus moves into the reveal), Entity (two-column row, selectable), Multi select (checkable listbox, per-row "Only"), Gauge (circular SVG ring, monochrome by default, tone shifts at 80%/95%). Dots menu and Filter params documented as existing Menu and Chips patterns — no new classes. Version 1.6.0: quieter field hover and focus, monochrome checked controls with ring-and-dot radios, Combobox, Choicebox, Input group, Copy, Theme switcher, Video. Version 1.5.0: Pager component, quieter field focus (ink border + soft halo), borderless tags with coloured status text. 1.4.0: interface details after Vercel (16px mobile inputs, labelled loading buttons, contained overlay scroll, balanced headings). 1.3.1: motion rules completed; dialogs and sheets play their exit. 1.3.0: the brand yellow is named Raggio. 1.2.5: 44px hit areas on buttons, links and the nav logo. 1.2.4: mobile nav underline sits under the words. 1.2.3: highlight is a tight Raggio band. 1.2.2: dark elevated #333333 and strong border #525252. 1.2.1: card hover uses the editorial line. 1.2.0: selection, content, sheet, data table, data viz and presentation layer
